params.body:
## Why

Delta's own-stock list had a switch per row (dealers with `send_to_hexon`) that set `send_to_modix`, the gate for publishing to the portal receivers (Hexon/DV, YourDailyDrive, FlexLease, Okasie webhooks; R S2-4.1). The Livewire list lost the column, the route `sendtomodix_single` is gone and the sheet does not write the flag either, so since the cutover there was no way to publish a vehicle or take it off the portals. In production the two flags are independent (677 complete unsold vehicles with both, 355 published only, 123 on Stocklist only, 814 neither), so `putOnStocklist` could not stand in for it.

## What changed

- **Portals panel of the row** (`_wagen_rij.blade.php`): one real switch "Publiceren op portalen" at the top, `role="switch"`, a 44px row, bound to `send_to_modix`. Shown for dealers with `send_to_hexon` (default 1, as the old column was), enabled on a complete unsold vehicle; a draft that still carries portals shows it locked with the reason. A sold vehicle has no panel (its status cell is the one chip "Verkocht"). The panel now also appears for a complete vehicle at a dealer with the link but no classifieds sites ("Geen portalen" as trigger), since publishing does not depend on the classifieds sites.
- **Confirmation**: the old sentences, `vehicle.send_to_modix_question` (without a Car-Pass with `…_without_carpass` as the line under it, R S2-4.3) and `vehicle.remove_from_modix_question`; cancel springs the switch back.
- **`OwnStockList::setPublish($id, $on)`**: owner, link, complete and unsold checks, then writes the one field through the repository so `VehicleObserver::updated` sees the flag turn and `VehiclePublisher` rings `create` (on) or `delete` (off), pinned in `OwnStockListTest`. `ui.notify` afterwards.
- **Row**: the portal icon strip dims (`ui-portal-icons-off`, title "Portalen: niet gepubliceerd") when the vehicle is not published; on a phone the strip is a 44px tap target since it is the only way to the switch there.
- **Rules**: R S2-4.8 (new), R P1-1.17 amended (the panel carries one real switch), open point on per-portal toggles updated (still open), finding `2026-09-15-publiceerschakelaar-verdween-met-de-livewire-lijst.md` (opgelost, ernst nu).

## Tests

`OwnStockRowMarkupTest` (+4: the switch, its questions, a published vehicle, a locked draft and no switch on a sold vehicle, the link-without-sites case; the two existing panel tests now pin a dealer without the link), `OwnStockListTest` (+2: create then delete, and what the door refuses). Guards green: `RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax|VehiclePublishing|VehiclePublisher`.

## Screenshots

1440 with the panel open and after confirming, 390 with the panel open: `.playwright-mcp/publish-switch/` in the worktree (not committed).
